acceptance_criteria.statement: Resolve architecture decisions against later authoritative source material while preserving earlier alternatives and evolution records.
Traceability, source context, completion evidence, and generated indexes represent the verified result without overstating runtime implementation.

definition_of_done: Applicable planning, decision, registry, or executable validation work is complete.
Acceptance criteria have current automated evidence.
Required tests pass for affected behavior.
Traceability and source context are current.
Security, licensing, and recovery implications are explicit.
No runtime or external verification is overstated.
description: Resolve architecture decisions against later authoritative source material while preserving earlier alternatives and evolution records.
exclusions: No claim of live external integration, deployed runtime, or production qualification.
objective: Resolve architecture decisions against later authoritative source material while preserving earlier alternatives and evolution records.
observability_impact: Records stable decision, component, upstream, test, and evidence identities for later telemetry correlation.
rationale: This bounded architecture and provenance work closes a scheduled design obligation with machine-readable records, tests, and evidence before runtime activation.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve prior valid records; generated indexes and summaries are deterministic and can be regenerated after rollback.
scope: Resolve architecture decisions against later authoritative source material while preserving earlier alternatives and evolution records.
security_impact: Records authority, dependency, licensing, secret, external-effect, and trust-boundary implications.
title: Reconcile architecture choices with source chronology and open decisions
